entries.title: Owlboy

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original release route and the best capture/fidelity path. Mac, Linux, Switch, PS4, and Xbox One ports do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Owlboy on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native desktop release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console releases are ports/access routes, not remasters or definitive editions. Physical and Limited Edition releases are collector packages, not separate content versions.
